authored_text_equivalence_note: If an image changes what the voter should do now, the controlling meaning is also recoverable in authored text or trustworthy text alternatives rather than only through browser inference.
authority_boundary_note: Generated image descriptions remain subordinate to the page's reviewed official text, authored text alternatives, and the named office/help lane the jurisdiction actually stands behind.
browser_image_description_surface_label: Example browser-generated image-description posture for official voter-information routes
current_help_recovery_note: When generated image descriptions are absent, ambiguous, or conflict-prone, the route points back to the current official help lane instead of pretending the inferred caption is authoritative.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official voter-information routes so browser- or platform-generated descriptions of unlabeled images remain subordinate to reviewed official text, alt text, and the named help lane rather than quietly becoming shadow explanatory copy.
generated_description_variance_note: Support, language coverage, privacy posture, and accuracy vary across browsers, platforms, screen-reader settings, and device classes.
privacy_and_processing_note: The service preserves route IDs, reviewed image classes, policy notes, and review timestamps rather than individualized generated captions, assistive-technology fingerprints, or raw screenshot collections.

reviewed_image_description_contexts.context_note: Reviewed browser or assistive-technology descriptions generated when an image lacks sufficient authored description.
Reviewed environments where generated descriptions are exposed only through spoken feedback or braille rather than visible text on the page.
Reviewed platform-generated descriptions computed locally on supported devices.
Reviewed whether the route still tells the truth when no generated description is available or enabled.
